title: 奏鳴の蒸気、断罪の旋律
author: 吟遊 ノクト

en.title: Resonating Steam, Melody of Condemnation
en.premise: In a floating city of gears, singing is magic, and music is the engine of civilization. But the echoes of the sacred hymn that once saved the world have transformed into a calamity, throwing the city's gears into chaos. A knight clutching a broken sword, a mechanic driven mad by the roar of steam engines, and a diva searching for the melody of truth—as their fates intertwine, the city's stalling clock begins to tick once more.

zh.title: 奏鸣之蒸汽，断罪之旋律
zh.premise: 在一座漂浮于天空的齿轮之城，歌声即是魔法，音乐驱动着文明。然而，曾经拯救世界的圣歌残响，如今却化作一场令城市齿轮陷入疯狂的灾厄。怀抱断剑的骑士，沉溺于蒸汽机轰鸣的修理工，以及追寻真实旋律的歌姬——众人的命运交织在一起，让这座几近停摆的城市之钟再次开始运转。
